note: DRAFT — Keyboard layout for a browser side-scroller (keyboard primary, mouse used for the basic attack and UI clicks). Keys can be remapped later; these are the v0 defaults. Number-row skill and potion hotkeys stay visible on a simple hotbar. Do not capture browser-reserved keys (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+W, F5). Placeholders.

rows.notes: Hold to walk left. Arrow keys are an alternative to WASD.
Variable jump in v0 is not required; a single fixed jump is fine for the prototype. W also jumps so WASD stays complete.
Optional. Drop through a one-way platform. Skip in v0.1 if platforms are all solid.
The default swing (skill multiplier 1.0). Does not spend MP.
Pick up a nearby drop, talk to an NPC, or use a path/portal when standing in its trigger. Hold is not required.
Skill hotkey 1. Warrior default: Power Strike.
Skill hotkey 3. Empty until a third skill is unlocked.
Skill hotkey 4. Empty until a fourth skill is unlocked.
Drink the first HP consumable in the potion bar (Meadow Dew by default if owned).
Drink the first MP consumable in the potion bar (Clear Dew by default if owned).
Toggle inventory. Esc also closes it.
Toggle the skills window (view ranks, pay a rank-up cost).
Toggle character / ability-point screen (STR, INT, AGI, SPI).
Toggle the passive tree (production, efficiency, Hunter's Luck).
Toggle the area map (Meadows areas and the current path).
Toggle the quest log. Optional for v0.1; useful once starter_quests are in.
Close the topmost window, or pause if no window is open. Does not quit the browser tab.
